description:
This is the official video introducing AI Fast & Comfort Cooling of the Bespoke AI WindFree Pro, Samsung's new room air conditioner.

Enjoy AI-tailored cooling! AI analyzes indoor and outdoor temperature, humidity, and even room size to automatically activate tailored cooling.
-Fast Cooling: for instant cooling
-WindFree™: for comfortable cooling
-Dry Comfort: for a cold-free, pleasant environment

AI will continuously monitor and learn your usage patterns & the room conditions, so it can automatically activate Fast Cooling. After lowering the temperature, AI switches to WindFree™ Cooling to maintain the ideal conditions. The more you use it, the better it will suit your needs.

Q: What is required to use AI Fast & Comfort Cooling?
A: A Wi-Fi connection and SmartThings are required.

#AIFastComfortableCooling #BespokeAIWindFreePro #AIsGotYou #BespokeAI #Samsung
